title: Pointers and references: addresses and safe passing

spans.text: A pointer stores an address; `&` gets an address and `*` accesses its value. A reference is another name for an existing object. Pass large objects as `const T&` to read or `T&` to modify without copying.

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: Check that a pointer is not `nullptr` and that its target is still alive before use. Avoid manual allocation with raw pointers while learning.
